newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - May 14.
newsitem.headline: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - May 14.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:
The bank releases its half year results early this aftrernoon.
Banks seen benefiting from government's savings plan unveiled in the 1997/98 budget. NAB to report half year results on Thursday.
Market digests bank's half year result released on Tuesday, St George says it sees further margin pressure.
Pharmaceutical group said before market open that government's plans to tighten spending on pharmaceutical benefits scheme was not expected to have a significant impact on company's bottom line.
Drug research group released on Tuesday key drug to combat bone-wastng disease osteoporosis.
Paper and packaging group said on Tuesday that the group's second half profit would be lower than both the year ago period and the 1996/97 first half.

Rupert Murdoch's media empire to hold press conference in Tokyo today on its Japanese satellite broadcasting venture JSkyB. News Corp also announced plans to buy Los Angeles Dodgers baseball team its first move into direct professional sports team ownership.
